body:
Protasis decides which skill or skills this observation upgrades. The filer is the wrong party to guess.

The generated skills payload is 24,956,643 bytes against the 25 MiB the skills CLI allows. That is 95.2 per cent of a ceiling this repository cannot move, and the margin has closed at every measurement.

## Observed

`tests/test_skills_sh_package.py` holds two ceilings from the CLI's own defaults, `SKILLS_EXTRACT_MAX_FILES` and `SKILLS_EXTRACT_MAX_BYTES`. Its comment records the file cap moving three times, at 1,000, 1,100 and 1,300, each time with the same reasoning: the pressure is repository-wide, no per-plugin trim closes it, and shipped package content is not trimmed to hold a count. This delivery raised it a fourth time, to 1,400, on those grounds.

The byte figure has moved with it, and that comment names it as the constraint the file count is not:

| Measured at | Bytes | Share of 25 MiB |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| The 1,100 raise | 23,160,342 | 88.3% |
| The 1,300 raise | 23,991,363 | 91.5% |
| Here | 24,956,643 | 95.2% |

`python3 scripts/portable_promise_machine.py package --out <dir>` writes the manifest those numbers come from. The remaining margin is 1,258,757 bytes.

## Why it matters here

The file cap has an escape: the comment above it explains why raising it stays honest, and three deliveries have used that escape. The byte cap has none. It is the CLI's default for its `well-known` and `download` source types, and this repository installs through `github`, which never consults either. So nothing fails today, and nothing will fail in hosted CI when the payload crosses 25 MiB. The first signal will be a package that those two install routes refuse, discovered by whoever used them.

Three deliveries have now written a paragraph predicting this. None could act on it, because each measured the payload while integrating something else.

## What this does not establish

That any particular content should leave the payload, that the `well-known` and `download` routes are used, or that 25 MiB is the right number. It establishes the margin and its direction, and that the next delivery to add shipped documents may be the one that closes it.

Fiat-Required: 1

Deciding what a payload of this size should carry, and whether the answer is an omission rule, a second package or a different distribution, is a design question with alternatives worth recording. One pull request that deletes files to buy margin is the outcome the file cap's own comment refuses.

```carryover
none | none | this filing carries one measurement and proposes no remedy; choosing one is the work it asks for
```

comments.body:
The margin is gone. This filing said the next delivery to add shipped documents might be the one to close it; skills#1153 is that delivery.

| Measured at | Bytes | Share of 25 MiB |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| The 1,100 raise | 23,160,342 | 88.3% |
| The 1,300 raise | 23,991,363 | 91.5% |
| This filing | 24,956,643 | 95.2% |
| skills#1153 | 26,272,101 | 100.2% |

1,377 files, 57,701 bytes over the ceiling.

What crossed it is the surface the obligation gate recomputes: the runtime specimens, their fixtures, and the plugin test modules the bindings name as their source. The payload carries the coverage manifest, so its own checker validates those bindings and cannot do it without them.

`MAX_BYTES` is unchanged there and `test_manifest_binds_every_runtime_file_to_source_bytes` is red. It mirrors the CLI's own default, so moving it would buy the package nothing and would only stop the test saying something true about the artefact. Deleting shipped content to buy margin is what this filing refuses. The red assertion is the signal asked for here, and it is recorded in that comment rather than silenced.

Nothing about that changes what this filing asks for: the design question is still open, and skills#1153 does not answer it.

Closing [#1467](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/issues/1467) with merged [PR #1554](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/pull/1554). The omission, reference-repair and headroom criteria have independent implementation evidence, and final main CI passed.

- Integration PR URL: [PR #1554](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/pull/1554)
- Final status: Closing this issue against the merged delivery after final main CI passed.
- Final main CI evidence: commit `b9f8e36b8b6210bcd023a68059ecb46da3e35769`; [`invariants`](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/actions/runs/34722718296/job/103631386306) concluded `success`.

Hosted root result: `Ran 1882 tests in 204.422s`; `OK (skipped=5)`. The five skips were one hook assertion for the hosted checkout and four existing checks requiring `jsonschema`, which is absent from the hosted interpreter. Local active root runs passed 1,882 tests with zero skips.

The recorded product package omits 32 decorative portraits and repairs 47 Markdown image references while retaining all 34 source portraits. Recorded byte ranges replay exactly. Its 18,668,573 complete bytes across 1,402 files leave 7,545,827 bytes below the unchanged 26,214,400-byte cap, exceeding the 5,242,880-byte reserve. Installed verification and packaged evaluation passed.

[Audit PR #1549](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/pull/1549) independently checked omission, transform and headroom; [audit PR #1552](https://github.com/wildcat-finance/skills/pull/1552) checked the later demonstration. Both remain unmerged review artefacts. PR #1515 and its existing controller remain a separate specification effort.
